rows.intro_en: Huashan Scenic Area, located in Huayin City, Weinan, Shaanxi Province, is home to Mount Hua, the Western Great Mountain of China's Five Great Mountains. Renowned for its precipitous terrain, it is known as 'the most breathtakingly perilous mountain under heaven.' With many Taoist historic sites on the mountain, it is a well-known mountaineering destination.

rows.intro_en: Sanhe Town is located in Feixi County, Hefei City. It is an ancient Jiangnan water town with a history of over two thousand years, situated at the confluence of the Fengle River, Hangbu River, and Xiaonan River. It is famous for its old streets, ancient bridges, and Huizhou-style architecture, and is a renowned tourist attraction.

The village's well-preserved Ming and Qing dynasty architecture, along with its quaint and elegant streets and ancestral halls, make it a great place to experience the traditional charm of a Jiangnan village.

The square lies on Beijing's Central Axis, measuring 880 meters from north to south and 500 meters from east to west, with an area of 440,000 square meters. rows.intro: 青岩镇，又称青岩古镇，是 下辖的一个乡镇级行政单位。 青岩古镇，贵州四大古镇之一，位于贵阳市南郊，建于明洪武十年（1378年），原为军事要塞 。古镇内设计精巧、工艺精湛的明清古建筑交错密布，寺庙、 楼阁画栋雕梁、飞角重檐相间。镇人文荟萃，有历史名人周渔璜、清末状元赵以炯（贵州历史上第一个文状元）。镇内有近代史上震惊中外的青岩教案遗址、赵状元府第、平刚先生故居、红军长征作战指挥部等历史文物。周恩来的父亲、邓颖超的母亲、李克农等革命前辈及其家属均在青岩秘密居住过。青岩古镇还是抗战期间浙江大学的西迁办学点之一。 2005年9月青岩古镇景区被建设部、国家文物局公布为第二批中国历史文化名镇。2013年在顶峰国际非物质文化遗产保护与传承旅游规划项目中被誉为中国最具魅力小镇之一。
rows.intro_en: Qingyan Town, also known as Qingyan Ancient Town, is one of the four great ancient towns of Guizhou. Located in the southern suburbs of Guiyang, it was built in 1378, the tenth year of the Hongwu reign of the Ming dynasty, originally as a military stronghold. The town is densely interwoven with ingenious, finely crafted Ming and Qing ancient buildings, where temples and pavilions with painted beams and carved columns, upturned eaves and layered roofs alternate. The town is rich in notable figures, including the historical celebrity Zhou Yuhuang and Zhao Yijiong, the top scholar (zhuangyuan) of the late Qing and the first civil top scholar in Guizhou's history. The town also holds historical relics such as the site of the Qingyan Missionary Case that shocked China and the world in modern history, the residence of Top Scholar Zhao, the former home of Mr. Ping Gang, and the Red Army Long March battle headquarters. Zhou Enlai's father, Deng Yingchao's mother, Li Kenong and other revolutionary veterans and their families all lived secretly in Qingyan at one time. Qingyan Ancient Town was also one of the relocated campuses of Zhejiang University during the War of Resistance. In September 2005 the Qingyan Ancient Town scenic area was named one of the second batch of Famous Historical and Cultural Towns of China by the Ministry of Construction and the State Administration of Cultural Heritage, and in 2013, in a peak international intangible cultural heritage protection and tourism planning project, it was hailed as one of China's most charming small towns.
rows.address_en: Guiyang Banmu Fangtang Inn (Qingyan Ancient Town Branch), Qingyan Ancient Town, Qingyan Town, Huaxi District, Guiyang, Guizhou, China

rows.intro_en: The Dujiangyan Irrigation System is located in Dujiangyan City, Chengdu, Sichuan. It is a large-scale water conservancy project built during the Warring States period under the direction of Li Bing and his son. For more than two thousand years, it has continued to serve irrigation and flood control functions, and is hailed as the origin of world water conservancy culture. It is now a national 5A-level scenic area and a World Cultural Heritage site.

rows.intro: 韶山是毛泽东的故乡。以其故居为核心保留与新建了一批文化与自然旅游景点，组成了韶山旅游区，1994年成为第3批国家级风景名胜区，2011年被评为湖南省第3个国家5A级旅游景区 。主要景区包括：故居、滴水洞、清溪与黑石寨。
rows.review_summary: 韶山旅游区既是赏花胜地，又坐拥历史建筑，游客可在此登高爬山，也可夜游观景，自然风光与人文景观兼备，游览体验丰富。
rows.intro_en: Shaoshan is the hometown of Mao Zedong. Centered on his Former Residence, a number of cultural and natural attractions have been preserved and newly built, forming the Shaoshan Tourist Area. It was designated a National Scenic Area in the third batch in 1994, and in 2011 it became Hunan Province's third national 5A-level tourist attraction. Its main scenic spots include the Former Residence, Dishui Cave (Dripping Water Cave), Qingxi, and Heishi Stockade.

rows.review_summary_en: Shaoshan Tourist Area is both a flower-viewing destination and home to historic buildings. Visitors can hike the hills here or take in the scenery on a night tour, enjoying both natural landscapes and cultural sights for a rich travel experience.

rows.address: 四川省成都市双流区黄龙溪镇川龙街1号黄龙溪古镇
rows.intro: 黄龙溪镇位于中国四川省成都市双流区下辖的一个乡镇级行政单位。 该镇位于双流区西南部边缘，地处双流区、彭山区、仁寿县的交界处，距成都市区约40公里，是中国历史文化名镇之一，鹿溪河在此汇入锦江。黄龙溪镇拥有2100多年的历史，汉代起便成为锦江上水路运输的重要一站。黄龙溪镇至今保留着较为完好的古镇格局和众多传统民俗活动，其中黄龙溪火龙灯舞、“府河号子”入选了中国国家级非物质文化遗产。2023年（第二届）中国文化百强镇。
rows.review_summary: 黄龙溪是遛娃宝藏地，很适合亲子同乐，这里有古镇古村和历史建筑可供观赏，还是赏花胜地，也可夜游观景、乘船游览。
rows.intro_en: Huanglongxi Town is a township-level administrative unit under the jurisdiction of Shuangliu District, Chengdu, Sichuan Province, China. Located on the southwestern edge of Shuangliu District, at the junction of Shuangliu District, Pengshan District, and Renshou County, it is about 40 kilometers from downtown Chengdu. It is one of China's Famous Historical and Cultural Towns, where the Luxi River flows into the Jinjiang River. Huanglongxi Town has a history of more than 2,100 years and has been an important stop on the waterway transport of the Jinjiang River since the Han Dynasty. The town still preserves a relatively intact ancient town layout and numerous traditional folk activities, among which the Huanglongxi Fire Dragon Lantern Dance and the "Fuhe Boatmen's Work Song" have been listed as national intangible cultural heritage of China. In 2023, it was named one of China's Top 100 Cultural Towns (second edition).

rows.review_summary_en: Huanglongxi is a hidden gem for outings with kids and is great for parent-child fun. Here you can admire the ancient town, ancient villages, and historical buildings. It is also a top spot for flower viewing, and you can enjoy night sightseeing and boat tours.

Located at the southwestern edge of Shuangliu District, at the junction of Shuangliu District, Pengshan District and Renshou County, about 40 kilometers from downtown Chengdu, it is one of China's Famous Historical and Cultural Towns, where the Luxi River flows into the Jinjiang River. With a history of more than 2,100 years, it has been an important stop on the Jinjiang waterway since the Han dynasty. The town retains a well-preserved ancient-town layout and numerous traditional folk activities, among which the Huanglongxi Fire Dragon Lantern Dance and the 'Fuhe Work Song' have been inscribed as national intangible cultural heritage of China. It was named one of the 2023 (second) Top 100 Cultural Towns of China.
